config.notes: Two page kinds. (1) www.latrobe.edu.au/courses/<slug>#/overview?studentType=int course pages: since 5 Oct stored in the INTERNATIONAL view (the page is drawn in the browser; the #/overview?studentType=int address is read through Firecrawl). Text: "Indicative course information for international students ... CRICOS code <code> Start dates [Indicative based on 2026 start dates] Semester 1 (March 2027), Semester 2 (July 2027), Summer (November 2027) Duration ... Learning mode ... Annual tuition fee A$45 600 per 120 credit points (120 credit points = one full-time year) ... English language requirement 6.5 IELTS (Academic) with no individual band less than 6.0". Intakes = months in brackets after Start dates; fee = international annual tuition fee; IELTS = overall score; student_type shows which view a page was read in (international/domestic). The fee is per 120 credit points (one full-time year) for the course year selected by default (the latest year offered). Research degrees print no start dates or fee. (2) handbook.latrobe.edu.au/courses/<year>/<code> handbook pages (Next.js, text only): Location(s) <campus> CRICOS code, Course duration (full time), Study level, AQF level, International onshore study option, Discontinued flag; no start dates, fees or IELTS; 2021-2024 pages are archived versions. Round 2: IELTS also from "IELTS (Academic): minimum overall band of 7.0" (nursing-type pages); not_admitting also flags "This course is not available to international students at the <campus> campus in <year>". Short courses print "Annual tuition fee A$20 700 full course duration (per 60 credit points)" - a whole-course amount, deliberately NOT read as the annual fee (the fee pattern needs "per" straight after the amount).
